# Plyos font

Listai embeds Plyos 0.100 in Regular, Italic, Bold, and Bold Italic styles. Plyos
is an authorial adaptation of the open-source
[Literata](https://github.com/googlefonts/literata) typeface, with Cyrillic and
Latin coverage.

Copyright 2017 The Literata Project Authors.
Copyright 2026 The Plyos Contributors.

The font files are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The complete
license is in [OFL.txt](OFL.txt) and is also packaged in the Android application
as the raw resource `plyos_ofl`.
